displayName: Build a client progress report from your project tools
summary: Pull project updates and email context into a clean client report.

useCases.title: Build a client progress report from your project tools
useCases.message: Help me put together a client progress report. Ask me which client and which time period to cover. Then pull relevant updates from my project tools and the email thread with the client, and draft a clean report I can send or present.

useCases.title: Build one client’s marketing performance report
useCases.message: Help me reconcile one client's project, analytics, advertising, and communication context into a reviewable performance report. Keep this client's accounts and data separate from every other account.
